relations: The worker's upper body gradually leans forward and rotates right, lowering his head while turning away from the press bed.
As the worker turns right, his right arm rotates out of view and becomes partly hidden behind his torso.
The glowing billet maintains its height and width on the fixed press bed, with no visible ram compression stroke.
The orange glow from the billet continues reflecting off the vertical columns, and the red-scale pattern remains largely unchanged.
caption: The video captures a dim industrial forging bay where a hydraulic press with vertical guide columns and a dark upper beam stands over a glowing workpiece on the press bed. The workpiece burns yellow-white at its core, mottled with red oxide scale, and its orange light reflects off the columns to either side. A worker seen from behind, in a yellow hard hat, ear muffs, a blue jacket with an orange yoke and a pale sleeve on his right arm, stands to the right of the billet. The billet holds roughly constant height and width on the bed, and no compression stroke of the ram is visible. The worker gradually moves and turns to the right, lowering his head and upper body into a forward-leaning posture. His right arm, initially hanging at his side, becomes partly hidden as he turns. The press structure and bed stay fixed while the camera appears static, so the red-scale pattern and column reflections persist largely unchanged.
